items.problem: No text sets when the entries that matching collected leave the queue. Step 3 and step 4 only say "creates a match with the collected entries" and "goes back to 1"; removal from the queue is written only for `TIMEOUT` (line 127), `MATCH_CANCEL`, close (line 122), and for a party entry only by inference from the status split of lines 89, 145 and 153 ("has a party entry" versus "became a match"). Match creation is async (game transaction of step 1 at line 161, `prepare_transport` at line 162), so frames of a collected solo user are handled during it. Run path: a solo user's entry is collected, and during the record save the user sends `ROOM_JOIN` (`ROOM_BUSY when in a room or queue`, line 144) or a second `MATCH_REQUEST` (step 1 at line 118 removes the user from the queue). An implementation that removes the entries at collection lets `ROOM_JOIN` succeed and keeps the match; one that removes them after `MATCH_FOUND` answers `ROOM_BUSY`, or lets step 1 remove the collected entry while the match is still created with that user. Direction: state that the collected entries are removed from the queue when they are collected, before match creation step 1.
